correctedCritiques.con-self-authored-human-purpose: Strongest feature: The move distinguishes evolutionary origins, purposive agency, self-authored projects, and externally assigned ultimate purpose, presenting a secular account without inflating finite significance into cosmic teleology. Principal limitation: Evolutionary explanation does not establish that transcendent purpose is absent, while the claim that purposes are exclusively self-given needs philosophical justification beyond the scientific mechanism invoked. Live burden: The position must explain why chosen finite projects remain genuinely meaningful, normatively assessable, and resilient despite mortality, while acknowledging that theism proposes an objectively grounded and enduring assignment. Locked score: The strong/competent band reflects precision, explicit qualification, coherence, charity, and a plausible account of practical meaning, tempered by incomplete worldview-level support and limited engagement with ultimate purpose's distinctive claim.
correctedCritiques.pro-created-human-worth-purpose: Strongest feature: The move presents an account of objective human significance through divine intention and image-bearing, contrasting externally grounded worth with finite, self-authored purpose. Principal limitation: Its language of infinite value supplies neither a metric nor a metaphysical mechanism, depends on the disputed creator premise, and leaves the secular account of objective morality or equal standing unanswered. Live burden: The defense must demonstrate how creation confers binding value, why divine intention sufficiently produces that result, and why finite self-authored projects cannot remain meaningful on their own terms. Locked score: The mixed band reflects central relevance, resonance, and partial engagement with secular purpose, constrained by overstated certainty, underdeveloped warrant, conceptual instability, and no contact with the separate secular-morality component.
